method.ordering: Alternating C++ and Rust order per round; medians computed within each paired session.
method.dependencies: Current authored fine funnel is an input to the mold, supplied by the normal producer graph.
method.scheduler_scope: The timing lease excludes other scheduler-managed heavy runs. Desktop and background services still run.
method.comparison_scope: Production generation and export. The optimized normal mold path omits unconsumed review analyses; the C++ reference normal path includes them. These are workflow measurements, not isolated like-for-like boolean-engine benchmarks.
method.variability: Absolute times rose in the later session across both implementations. Compare paired results within a session; no universal boolean speedup is inferred.

causes_and_changes.cause: Dense outline sampling repeatedly probes the same nearby flute stations.
causes_and_changes.change: Sorted station bounds restrict candidates, then nearest uniform source samples and the original endpoint preserve the discrete hit criterion.
causes_and_changes.numeric_rule: Original sample spacing, distance predicate and endpoint expression are retained.

causes_and_changes.cause: The mold reconstructs the finished funnel and unused bores, then runs analyses whose results are not consumed by ordinary website or print generation.
causes_and_changes.change: Import the current authored fine funnel, generate only the forming exterior, and run backing, containment and component checks on explicit --review.
Reuse the column prism and expose the existing exterior construction without generating an unused bore.

causes_and_changes.cause: Hot scalar intersection helpers are not consistently inlined under the workspace release profile.
causes_and_changes.change: Add #[inline(always)] to interpolate, shadow01, kernel11, kernel02 and kernel12.
causes_and_changes.numeric_rule: No arithmetic or boolean algorithm changes.
causes_and_changes.cache_binding: The engine implementation digest participates in geometry versioning, retained-stage keys and native producer source inputs.
